title: On the possibilities and limitations of LLM-based multi-agent systems for multi-criteria decision-making in healthcare operations management

paragraphs.en: Multi-criteria models for healthcare operations need weights that express how stakeholders trade off patient waiting time, provider workload, and operating cost, but these weights are difficult to quantify. Teams of large language model (LLM) agents, each prompted to represent a stakeholder, have been used to supply them. We propose a framework for assessing the reliability of LLM-generated preferences as inputs to multi-objective optimization and quantifying how their uncertainty affects decisions. We study explicit preferences by asking agents to rate the importance of the criteria in an outpatient appointment scheduling problem, and implicit preferences by inferring trade-offs from the agents’ pairwise choices between emergency department configurations. The computational experiments show that the explicit preferences respond to the clinic’s operating conditions and differ across roles, but deliberation among the agents can erase these differences, whereas simple averaging preserves them. The pairwise choices used to reveal the agents’ implicit preferences depend largely on which option is presented first, and we find limited evidence that a statistical model using contextual information alongside presentation order predicts the agents’ choices on new comparison pairs better than a model using presentation order alone. We then formulate robust weighted-sum optimization models to account for preference uncertainty. In most cases, these models select different schedules or configurations from those obtained using average preference weights. These results indicate that LLM-generated preferences need an audit of this kind before they are used as optimization weights in healthcare decision support.
paragraphs.zh: 医疗运营的多标准模型需要权重来体现利益相关者如何在患者等待时间、服务提供方工作负荷和运营成本之间进行权衡，但这些权重难以量化。 由大型语言模型（LLM）智能体组成的团队已被用于提供这些权重，其中每个智能体都被提示代表一个利益相关者。 我们提出了一种框架，用于评估 LLM 生成的偏好作为多目标优化输入时的可靠性，并量化其不确定性如何影响决策。 我们通过要求智能体对外科门诊预约调度问题中各项标准的相对重要性进行评分，来研究显性偏好；通过从智能体在急诊科不同配置之间的成对选择中推断权衡关系，来研究隐性偏好。 计算实验表明，显性偏好会响应诊所的运营条件并在不同角色间存在差异，但智能体之间的讨论可以消除这些差异，而简单的平均法则会保留这些差异。 用于揭示智能体隐性偏好的成对选择在很大程度上取决于哪个选项被首先呈现；我们发现，结合上下文信息和呈现顺序的统计模型在预测智能体对新比较对的选择方面，效果仅略优于仅使用呈现顺序的模型。 接着，我们构建了稳健的加权求和优化模型，以应对偏好中的不确定性。 在大多数情况下，这些模型所选的调度或配置与使用平均偏好权重所得到的结果不同。 这些结果表明，在将 LLM 生成的偏好用作医疗决策支持中的优化权重之前，需要进行此类审核。

paragraphs.en: Operational decisions in healthcare are inherently multi-criteria. In outpatient clinics, an appointment schedule trades patient waiting time against provider idle time and overtime [ 9 , 13 , 27 ] . In emergency departments (EDs), dedicated pathways for low-acuity patients are widely used to reduce crowding and waiting times, but they require additional staffed opening hours [ 6 ] . Different stakeholders value these criteria differently [ 24 , 27 ] : patients primarily care about waiting, providers about workload and overtime, and operations staff about capacity use and cost. Multi-objective optimization characterizes such conflicts through Pareto-optimal solutions, which represent trade-offs among the criteria and provide alternatives for managers to consider [ 6 ] . Scalarization methods, such as the weighted-sum method, use preference information to combine multiple criteria into a single objective and guide the search for a preferred solution [ 43 , 16 , 1 , 31 , 22 ] . In practice, the weights are often chosen informally and then treated as fixed, in healthcare and other scheduling applications [ 35 , 39 ] , although they may vary across stakeholders and operating conditions and are difficult to state numerically [ 27 , 9 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 医疗领域的运营决策本质上属于多标准决策。 在门诊诊所中，预约安排需要在患者等待时间与医护人员空闲时间及加班时间之间进行权衡 [ 9 , 13 , 27 ] 。 在急诊科（EDs），为低危患者设立专门的诊疗通道被广泛用于减少拥挤和等待时间，但这需要额外配备人员并在特定时段开放 [ 6 ] 。 不同利益相关者对这些标准的重视程度各不相同 [ 24 , 27 ]：患者主要关注等待时间，医护人员关注工作负荷和加班情况，而运营人员则关注资源利用效率和成本。 多目标优化通过帕累托最优解来描述此类冲突，这些解体现了各标准之间的权衡关系，并为管理者提供了可供选择的替代方案 [ 6 ] 。 标量化方法（如加权求和法）利用偏好信息将多个标准整合为单一目标，从而指导对优选方案的搜索 [ 43 , 16 , 1 , 31 , 22 ] 。 在实践中，无论是在医疗领域还是其他调度应用中，权重通常以非正式方式确定，随后被当作固定值处理 [ 35 , 39 ]；尽管这些权重可能因利益相关者和运营条件的不同而有所差异，且难以用数值明确表达 [ 27 , 9 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) offer a new route to these weights. An agent prompted with a stakeholder role can report weights on demand and for each operating condition, whereas eliciting them from patients, providers, and managers is slow and difficult to repeat. Recent work in multi-criteria decision making (MCDM) uses LLM agents to translate qualitative judgments into numerical criterion weights and to reconcile several “expert” viewpoints through structured multi-agent procedures [ 57 ] , uses LLMs as automated evaluators within MCDM pipelines [ 60 ] , or lets an LLM select among multi-objective alternatives directly from stated priorities [ 36 ] . Multi-agent LLM systems in which agents play distinct roles are now a general paradigm for planning and coordination [ 26 ] , and a team of agents mirroring the stakeholders of a healthcare system, such as an outpatient clinic or an ED, is a natural instance of this design. However, it is unclear whether the preferences generated by these agents are reliable enough to be used in multi-objective optimization. LLM outputs vary across repeated queries [ 2 , 53 ] and prompt formulations [ 2 ] ; their choices can change when the same two options are presented in reverse order [ 70 , 62 ] ; they tend to adapt their answers to the views stated by their users [ 52 ] ; and agents may drift from their assigned personas toward the model’s default positions [ 55 , 12 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）为获取这些权重提供了一种新途径。 若赋予智能体利益相关者的角色，它便可根据需求、针对每种运行条件报告权重；而直接从患者、服务提供者和管理者处获取这些权重则既缓慢又难以重复操作。 近期关于多标准决策（MCDM）的研究中，有研究利用 LLM 智能体将定性判断转化为数值化的标准权重，并通过结构化的多智能体流程协调多位“专家”的观点 [57]；也有研究将 LLM 用作 MCDM 流程中的自动化评估工具 [60]；还有的研究则让 LLM 根据明确给出的优先级直接从多目标备选方案中进行选择 [36]。 由不同角色智能体组成的多智能体 LLM 系统，如今已成为规划与协调的一种通用范式 [26]；而一个模仿医疗系统（如门诊诊所或急诊科）中利益相关者的智能体团队，正是这种设计的典型实例。 然而，这些智能体生成的偏好是否足够可靠，能够用于多目标优化，目前尚不清楚。 LLM 的输出在不同重复查询 [2, 53] 和不同提示设计 [2] 下存在差异；当同一两个选项以相反顺序呈现时，其选择也可能发生变化 [70, 62]；它们往往会根据用户表达的观点调整回答 [52]；此外，智能体还可能偏离其设定的角色，转而趋向模型默认的位置 [55, 12]。

paragraphs.en: In high-stakes settings, decision support should be transparent and interpretable [ 50 ] , since opaque algorithms can encode hidden biases [ 45 ] . This requirement becomes more pressing as data-driven optimization tools are deployed in healthcare operations [ 4 , 5 ] . Weights generated by LLM agents put this requirement at risk, because they inherit the inconsistencies listed above and no external reference exists against which to check them. We propose a framework for Preference Assessment and Decision Analysis for LLM-based agents (LLM-PADA) that audits LLM-generated preferences before they are used as inputs to multi-objective optimization and quantifies how their uncertainty affects decisions. The framework considers two mechanisms. The first mechanism is explicit preference elicitation , studied in outpatient appointment scheduling. Here, intake, provider, and scheduler agents rate the importance of patient waiting time, provider idle time, and provider overtime on a 1 1 – 9 9 scale. The agents then revise their ratings over three rounds under a numerical protocol, in which they exchange scores, or an argumentative protocol, in which they also exchange justifications and objections. Both are compared with a mechanical protocol that averages the scores without further LLM calls. The second mechanism is implicit preference inference , studied in an ED in which eligible low-acuity patients can be routed to a minor injuries unit (MIU). Rather than reporting weights, agents with patient, physician, and operations perspectives choose between pairs of nondominated configurations taken from the discrete-event simulation study of Boresta et al. [6] , described by their average waiting time and weekly MIU opening hours.
paragraphs.zh: 在高风险场景中，决策支持应当具备透明性和可解释性 [ 50 ]，因为不透明的算法可能会编码隐藏偏见 [ 45 ]。 随着数据驱动优化工具在医疗运营中的部署，这一要求变得愈发紧迫 [ 4 , 5 ]。 LLM 智能体生成的权重使这一要求面临风险，因为它们继承了上述列出的不一致性，且不存在可用于验证这些权重的外部参考标准。 我们提出了一种面向基于 LLM 的智能体的偏好评估与决策分析框架（LLM-PADA），该框架会在将 LLM 生成的偏好用作多目标优化的输入之前进行审查，并量化其不确定性对决策的影响。 该框架考虑了两种机制。 第一种机制是显式偏好 elicitation，已在门诊预约调度领域进行了研究。 在此过程中，接诊、医疗提供者和调度智能体会在 1–9 的尺度上评估患者等待时间、医疗提供者空闲时间和医疗提供者加班时间的重要性。 随后，这些智能体会在三轮迭代中根据数值协议修订其评分（在此协议中，它们会交换分数），或根据论证协议修订评分（在此协议中，它们还会交换理由和反对意见）。 这两种机制都与一种机械式协议进行了比较，该协议仅对分数取平均值，不再调用 LLM。 第二种机制是隐式偏好推断，已在急诊科（ED）场景中进行研究，在该场景中，符合条件的低危患者可以被转至轻伤单元（MIU）。 与报告权重不同，具有患者、医生和运营视角的智能体会在 Boresta 等人离散事件模拟研究中选取的一组非支配配置对之间做出选择。 [6]，这些配置通过平均等待时间和每周 MIU 开放时间来描述。

paragraphs.en: The LLM-PADA framework has four steps. First, we obtain preferences through explicit preference elicitation or implicit preference inference. Second, we assess the reliability of the resulting preferences by examining how they respond to the decision context and how they are affected by the procedure used to obtain them. Here, reliability refers to internal checks (context sensitivity, role differentiation, and stability under changes in procedure and presentation order), not to agreement with human stakeholder preferences. Third, we construct uncertainty sets for the criterion weights from the elicited or inferred preferences. Fourth, following the multiexpert multicriteria robust weighted-sum (McRow) approach of Hu and Mehrotra [ 31 ] , we formulate robust weighted-sum optimization models over these sets to quantify how accounting for preference uncertainty changes decisions. We demonstrate the LLM-PADA framework in outpatient appointment scheduling and emergency department planning using locally executed models of the Qwen3.5 family [ 66 ] . Although our computational experiments focus on two healthcare contexts and locally executed models, the framework is general and can be used for other healthcare operations problems and with proprietary LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: LLM-PADA 框架包含四个步骤。 首先，我们通过显式偏好获取或隐式偏好推断来获得偏好。 其次，我们通过检验这些偏好对决策情境的反应以及它们受获取偏好所用程序的影响程度，来评估所得偏好的可靠性。 此处，可靠性指的是内部检查（情境敏感性、角色区分，以及在程序和呈现顺序变化下的稳定性），而非与人类利益相关者的偏好一致。 第三，我们从获取或推断出的偏好中构建准则权重的不确定性集合。 第四，遵循 Hu 和 Mehrotra [31] 的多专家多标准稳健加权求和（McRow）方法，我们在这些集合上构建稳健加权求和优化模型，以量化考虑偏好不确定性如何改变决策。 我们使用 Qwen3.5 系列本地执行模型 [66]，在门诊预约安排和急诊科规划中演示了 LLM-PADA 框架。 尽管我们的计算实验聚焦于两个医疗场景和本地执行模型，但该框架具有通用性，可用于其他医疗运营问题，也可与专有大型语言模型结合使用。

paragraphs.en: This paper makes three contributions: (i) we introduce the LLM-PADA framework, which assesses the reliability of LLM-generated preferences before they are used as objective weights and measures how accounting for their uncertainty changes decisions by comparing mean-weight and robust weighted-sum models; the two models select different decisions in ten of the sixteen outpatient comparisons and in five of the six emergency department comparisons; (ii) for explicit preferences in outpatient appointment scheduling, we develop an approach that first elicits importance scores from agents with different stakeholder roles and then compares three ways of revising these scores: two LLM deliberation protocols, in which agents exchange scores alone or scores with arguments, and mechanical averaging; experiments with prompts describing different clinic conditions show that LLM deliberation can weaken their responses to these conditions and erase or reverse role differences, whereas mechanical averaging retains role differentiation; (iii) for implicit preferences in ED planning, we propose an approach to estimate trade-off weights from agents’ choices between pairs of ED configurations described by two outcomes; we use a choice model that accounts for which alternative is presented first and evaluate it on other pairs not used for estimation; we find evidence that outcome differences improve prediction of the agents’ choices beyond presentation order for only two of the six combinations of model and role.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了三项贡献：（i）我们引入了 LLM-PADA 框架，该框架在将大型语言模型（LLM）生成的偏好用作目标权重之前，会评估其可靠性，并通过比较均值加权模型与稳健加权求和模型，衡量考虑这些偏好的不确定性如何改变决策；在这十六项门诊比较中，两种模型有十项选择了不同的决策，在六项急诊科比较中则有五项选择了不同决策；（ii）针对门诊预约安排中的显性偏好，我们开发了一种方法：首先从具有不同利益相关者角色的智能体中获取重要性评分，然后比较三种修订这些评分的方式——两种 LLM 审议协议（其中智能体仅交换评分，或同时交换评分与论证），以及机械平均法；使用描述不同诊所条件的提示词进行的实验表明，LLM 审议会削弱智能体对这些条件的反应，并消除或逆转角色差异，而机械平均法则能保留角色间的区分；（iii）针对急诊科规划中的隐性偏好，我们提出了一种方法，通过智能体在由两种结果描述的急诊科配置对之间的选择来估计权衡权重；我们使用一种考虑了哪个选项先被呈现的选择模型，并在未用于估计的其他配置对上对其进行评估；我们的研究结果表明，对于模型与角色的六种组合中仅有两种，结果差异在预测智能体的选择时，其效果能超越呈现顺序的影响。

Consider problems of the form min x ∈ X ⁡ f ⁡ ( x ) = ( f 1 ​ ( x ) , … , f q ​ ( x ) ) \min_{x\in X}f(x)=(f_{1}(x),\ldots,f_{q}(x)) with q ≥ 2 q\geq 2 objectives, where X ⊆ ℝ n X\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{n} is the feasible set in the decision space, possibly discrete as in our applications, and f f maps it into the objective space ℝ q \mathbb{R}^{q} . Given x , x ¯ ∈ X x,\bar{x}\in X , we say that x ¯ \bar{x} dominates x x (and f ⁡ ( x ¯ ) f(\bar{x}) dominates f ⁡ ( x ) f(x) ) if f ⁡ ( x ¯ ) ≤ f ⁡ ( x ) f(\bar{x})\leq f(x) componentwise and f ⁡ ( x ¯ ) ≠ f ⁡ ( x ) f(\bar{x})\neq f(x) . A solution in X X is Pareto optimal if no x ¯ ∈ X \bar{x}\in X dominates it, and we denote the set of Pareto-optimal (or efficient) solutions by X E X_{\mathrm{E}} . A point f ⁡ ( x ) f(x) is nondominated if x ∈ X E x\in X_{\mathrm{E}} , and the Pareto front is the set of all nondominated points, { f ⁡ ( x ) | x ∈ X E } \{f(x)~|~x\in X_{\mathrm{E}}\} . Pareto optimality is thus a property of solutions in the decision space, whereas nondominance is a property of points in the objective space. Any two distinct nondominated points involve a trade-off, since each is better than the other in at least one objective, so choosing among them requires preference information [ 16 , 43 ] .

paragraphs.en: Multi-objective optimization methods compute Pareto-optimal solutions, and hence nondominated points, and they differ in when preference information enters [ 16 , 43 ] . A priori methods require preference information before solving, in order to identify a preferred solution. A posteriori methods instead approximate the entire set of nondominated points in the objective space, which captures all trade-offs but can be computationally expensive, and the decision maker then selects a preferred point in a post-processing step. Interactive methods bring in the decision maker’s preferences progressively during the optimization, with the goal of identifying a preferred solution. The weighted-sum method is a standard a priori method that combines the objectives into a single one using weights that reflect the decision maker’s preferences, and then solves the resulting single-objective problem [ 16 , 43 ] .

paragraphs.en: Recent surveys document the rapid emergence of LLM-based multi-agent systems as a general paradigm for decision making, highlighting their advantages over single-agent designs in complex, multi-step environments [ 26 ] . A single agent usually works in a loop where the model alternates between reasoning and acting [ 67 ] , and it can call external tools, such as calculators or search engines, through APIs [ 51 ] . Multi-agent systems instead give each agent a narrower role, and they differ in how the agents are organized. In hierarchical designs, a coordinating agent hands subtasks to other agents, as in AutoGen [ 63 ] and in layered leader–employee networks [ 28 ] . In peer-to-peer designs, agents talk to each other directly by playing roles [ 37 ] . In protocol-based designs, specialized agents follow prescribed interaction patterns, as in MetaGPT [ 30 ] , ChatDev [ 47 ] , and MDTeamGPT [ 11 ] . A further pattern, particularly relevant under conflicting objectives, is structured deliberation, in which agents represent different viewpoints and, over several rounds, critique and revise each other’s positions [ 23 ] . For such systems, performance should be assessed not only by end-to-end task success but also by properties such as consistency across repeated runs [ 68 ] . For deliberative systems, the agreement induced by the protocol is a further property of interest [ 55 , 12 ] . We use this deliberative design for explicit preferences. The agents revise their scores for three rounds, and no single agent makes the final decision.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究记录了基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统的快速兴起，这已成为一种通用的决策范式，并凸显了其在复杂多步骤环境中相较于单智能体设计的优势 [26]。 单个智能体通常在循环中运行，模型在推理和行动之间交替进行 [67]，并且可以通过 API 调用外部工具，例如计算器或搜索引擎 [51]。 相比之下，多智能体系统为每个智能体分配了更狭窄的角色，而智能体的组织方式则各不相同。 在分层设计中，协调智能体将子任务分配给其他智能体，例如 AutoGen [63] 和分层领导者-员工网络 [28]。 在点对点设计中，智能体通过扮演不同角色直接相互沟通 [37]。 在基于协议的设计中，专门的智能体遵循预设的交互模式，例如 MetaGPT [30]、ChatDev [47] 和 MDTeamGPT [11]。 另一种模式尤其适用于存在冲突目标的情况，即结构化审议：智能体代表不同观点，经过多轮讨论，相互批评并修正彼此的观点 [23]。 对于此类系统，其性能评估不应仅基于端到端任务的完成度，还应考虑重复运行中的一致性等特性 [68]。 对于审议类系统，协议所促成的共识是另一个值得关注的特性 [55, 12]。 我们使用这种审议式设计来处理明确的偏好。 智能体经过三轮评分修正后，最终决策由所有智能体共同决定，而非由单个智能体单独做出。

sents.zh: 在点对点设计中，智能体通过扮演不同角色直接相互沟通 [37]。

sents.en: In protocol-based designs, specialized agents follow prescribed interaction patterns, as in MetaGPT [ 30 ] , ChatDev [ 47 ] , and MDTeamGPT [ 11 ] .
sents.zh: 在基于协议的设计中，专门的智能体遵循预设的交互模式，例如 MetaGPT [30]、ChatDev [47] 和 MDTeamGPT [11]。

sents.en: A further pattern, particularly relevant under conflicting objectives, is structured deliberation, in which agents represent different viewpoints and, over several rounds, critique and revise each other’s positions [ 23 ] .
sents.zh: 另一种模式尤其适用于存在冲突目标的情况，即结构化审议：智能体代表不同观点，经过多轮讨论，相互批评并修正彼此的观点 [23]。

sents.en: For such systems, performance should be assessed not only by end-to-end task success but also by properties such as consistency across repeated runs [ 68 ] .
sents.zh: 对于此类系统，其性能评估不应仅基于端到端任务的完成度，还应考虑重复运行中的一致性等特性 [68]。

sents.en: For deliberative systems, the agreement induced by the protocol is a further property of interest [ 55 , 12 ] .
sents.zh: 对于审议类系统，协议所促成的共识是另一个值得关注的特性 [55, 12]。

sents.en: We use this deliberative design for explicit preferences.
sents.zh: 我们使用这种审议式设计来处理明确的偏好。

sents.en: The agents revise their scores for three rounds, and no single agent makes the final decision.
sents.zh: 智能体经过三轮评分修正后，最终决策由所有智能体共同决定，而非由单个智能体单独做出。

paragraphs.en: A growing literature uses LLM agents to produce the preference information that multi-criteria decision models require. In multi-criteria decision making (MCDM), Vahidnia [ 57 ] , whose procedure inspired our explicit elicitation, obtains initial criterion weights from multiple LLM instances acting as experts and then enforces agreement through an aggregation-and-convergence procedure that removes outliers and iteratively moves the group weights toward the global mean until the well-known Kendall’s coefficient of concordance stabilizes. This convergence step is applied mechanically rather than through LLM deliberation, and is therefore close to the mechanical averaging baseline of our explicit study. Wang et al. [ 60 ] propose a general LLM-based MCDM framework in which LLMs replace human experts in rating the alternatives on each criterion, while the criterion weights are obtained with the analytic hierarchy process. They show that off-the-shelf models reach only moderate accuracy against expert judgments, whereas fine-tuning open-source models on the task brings them close to expert level. Jovine et al. [ 36 ] introduce LISTEN, an LLM framework for selecting one item from a large set of alternatives described by multiple attributes. LISTEN-U asks an LLM to translate a natural-language description of priorities into a linear utility function and to revise its coefficients iteratively, and is therefore similar to our explicit-preference protocol, but it does not involve deliberation among agents representing different stakeholder roles. LISTEN-T samples batches of alternatives, asks the LLM to select a winner from each batch, and conducts a final tournament among the winners. Both LISTEN-T and our implicit-preference protocol obtain information through choices, but LISTEN-T uses the choices directly to select a candidate, whereas we treat them as observations, estimate a choice model that separates attribute effects from presentation effects, quantify the uncertainty of the inferred trade-off, and evaluate the resulting decisions through mean-weight and robust optimization. In all these works, the LLM output is treated as the preference to be used. We ask instead whether it is reliable enough to be used, and what happens to the decisions when it is not.
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的研究开始利用大型语言模型（LLM）智能体来生成多标准决策模型所需的偏好信息。在多标准决策（MCDM）领域，Vahidnia [57] 的方法启发了我们的显式偏好 elicitation 方法。他从多个充当专家的 LLM 实例中获取初始标准权重，然后通过聚合与收敛过程强制达成一致：该过程会剔除异常值，并迭代地将群体权重向全局均值靠拢，直到著名的肯德尔协调系数稳定为止。这一收敛步骤是机械执行的，而非通过 LLM 的 deliberation，因此与我们显式研究中的机械平均基线较为接近。Wang 等人 [60] 提出了一种通用的基于 LLM 的 MCDM 框架，其中 LLM 取代了人类专家，负责对各备选方案在各个标准上的表现进行评分，而标准权重则通过层次分析法获得。他们发现，现成的模型在准确性上仅能达到中等水平，难以与专家判断相媲美；而将开源模型针对该任务进行微调后，其表现可接近专家水平。Jovine 等人 [36] 提出了 LISTEN——一种用于从包含多个属性的庞大备选方案集中选择一个项目的 LLM 框架。LISTEN-U 要求 LLM 将优先级的自然语言描述转化为线性效用函数，并迭代地修正其系数，因此与我们的显式偏好协议相似，但它并不涉及代表不同利益相关者角色的智能体之间的 deliberation。LISTEN-T 则通过采样备选方案的批次、让 LLM 从每个批次中选出优胜者，并最终在优胜者之间进行一轮对决。LISTEN-T 和我们的隐式偏好协议都通过选择来获取信息，但 LISTEN-T 直接利用这些选择来挑选候选方案，而我们则将其视为观察数据，据此估计一个能够区分属性效应与呈现效应的选择模型，量化推断出的权衡关系的不确定性，并通过平均权重和鲁棒优化来评估最终的决策。在所有这些研究中，LLM 的输出都被直接视为待使用的偏好信息。而我们的问题则是：这种输出是否足够可靠以供使用？如果不够可靠，又会如何影响最终的决策？

paragraphs.en: Studies of LLM behavior raise concerns about using agents as reliable sources of stakeholder preferences. Gao et al. [ 21 ] warn against using LLMs as surrogates for human participants, showing that in a strategic reasoning game their behavior can differ markedly from that of humans. Additionally, LLM answers can be inconsistent beyond the variability induced by sampling and paraphrasing. For example, Ahn and Yin [ 2 ] show that a model may give conflicting answers when asked which candidates are correct and which are incorrect, and an informal test in which the same questions were posed twice to several commercial chatbots produced contradictory answers [ 53 ] . In medical tasks, the consistency of LLM outputs depends on prompt design [ 61 ] , and suboptimal repeatability has been reported even for a structured disaster-triage protocol [ 19 ] , although accuracy on clinical prediction tasks has been found to be largely insensitive to sampling temperature [ 46 ] . Interaction among agents raises a further concern. Multi-agent debate, in which agents critique and revise one another’s answers over several rounds to reach a common answer, has been proposed to improve factuality and reasoning [ 14 ] . Agreement, however, is not necessarily informative, as the following examples show: in simulated political debates, role-playing agents drift from their assigned personas toward the model’s own default positions [ 55 ] ; models trained with human feedback tend to adapt their answers to the views stated by their users [ 52 ] ; and in simulated debates groups of LLM agents converge more strongly than groups of humans [ 12 ] . These studies concern factual questions or opinions on social topics. In a team of stakeholder agents, the same tendencies could erase the very differences in priorities that justify having a team. Our explicit-preference study therefore measures agreement separately from whether the agents keep their contextual and role-specific priorities , and it compares LLM deliberation with a mechanical averaging rule that involves no LLM calls.
paragraphs.zh: 对大型语言模型（LLM）行为的研究引发了关于将智能体用作利益相关者偏好可靠来源的担忧。Gao 等人 [ 21 ] 警告不要将 LLM 用作人类参与者的替代，研究指出，在策略推理游戏中，LLM 的行为可能与人类存在显著差异。 此外，LLM 的答案除了受采样和改写引起的变异影响外，本身也可能不一致。 例如，Ahn 和 Yin [ 2 ] 的研究表明，当被问及哪些选项正确、哪些错误时，模型可能会给出相互矛盾的答案；一项非正式测试中，向多个商业聊天机器人重复提出相同问题，也产生了相互矛盾的回答 [ 53 ] 。 在医疗任务中，LLM 输出的稳定性取决于提示词的设计 [ 61 ]，即使对于结构化的灾难分诊流程，也报告了重复性不佳的情况 [ 19 ]；不过，临床预测任务的准确性在很大程度上不受采样温度的影响 [ 46 ]。 智能体之间的相互作用引发了另一个担忧。 多智能体辩论已被提出用于提升事实性和推理能力：在此过程中，智能体会经过多轮相互批评和修正彼此的答案，最终达成一致 [ 14 ]。 然而，一致性并不一定具有信息价值，如下列例子所示：在模拟的政治辩论中，角色扮演智能体会偏离其设定的人设，转而趋向模型自身的默认立场 [ 55 ]；经人类反馈训练的模型往往会调整答案以迎合用户表达的观点 [ 52 ]；而在模拟辩论中，LLM 智能体群体的收敛程度比人类群体更强 [ 12 ]。 这些研究涉及事实性问题或对社会议题的看法。 在由利益相关者智能体组成的团队中，同样的倾向可能会消除设立团队所依据的那些优先事项差异本身。 因此，我们的显式偏好研究将一致性测量与智能体是否保持其情境和角色特定的优先事项分开处理，并将 LLM 的审议过程与一个不涉及任何 LLM 调用的机械平均规则进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: Our implicit-preference study builds on classical models of pairwise choice. The Bradley–Terry model assigns a latent score to each alternative and models the probability that one is preferred to the other as a logistic function of the difference between their scores [ 7 ] . Random-utility models with logit choice probabilities extend this by expressing the probabilities in terms of the alternatives’ attributes [ 42 ] . The reward models used to align LLMs with human feedback have the same structure and are fitted to pairwise human comparisons [ 69 ] . We use the structure the other way around: the LLM agent is the respondent, the alternatives are simulated ED operating configurations described by two outcomes, and the ratio of the fitted outcome coefficients gives the weight in a weighted-sum objective. Studies of LLMs as judges of pairwise comparisons find that their verdicts depend on the order in which the alternatives are presented [ 70 , 62 ] . Our choice model therefore includes a presentation term , and we assess its predictive value against a benchmark that uses presentation order alone.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的隐含偏好研究建立在经典成对选择模型的基础之上。 Bradley–Terry 模型为每个选项分配一个潜在得分，并将一个选项优于另一个选项的概率建模为两者得分差异的 logistic 函数 [ 7 ] 。 采用 logit 选择概率的随机效用模型对此进行了扩展，将概率表示为各选项属性的函数 [ 42 ] 。 用于使 LLM 与人类反馈对齐的奖励模型具有相同的结构，并且是根据人类的成对比较进行拟合的 [ 69 ] 。 我们将这一结构反向应用：LLM 智能体是回应者，各个选项是由两个结果描述的模拟 ED 运行配置，而拟合出的结果系数之比则构成了加权求和目标函数中的权重。 将 LLM 用作成对比较评判者的研究发现，其判断结果取决于选项呈现的顺序 [ 70 , 62 ] 。 因此，我们的选择模型包含一个呈现项，并且我们将其预测价值与仅使用呈现顺序的基准模型进行比较评估。

paragraphs.en: When the weights used to represent a decision maker’s preferences and combine objectives into a single objective are uncertain, robust optimization [ 3 ] protects against the worst case over a set of plausible weights or utilities. Minmax robustness for multi-objective problems with uncertain parameters is formalized by Ehrgott et al. [ 17 ] , and Hu and Mehrotra [ 31 ] study robust and stochastically weighted multiobjective models in which the weights belong to an uncertainty set. Our robust problems are deterministic instances of their multi-expert multi-criteria robust weighted sum (McRow) approach. A related literature, known as preference robust optimization (PRO), constructs ambiguity sets of utility functions from partial information elicited from the decision maker. Hu and Mehrotra [ 32 ] formulate a maximin model over a set of risk-averse utilities, Wu et al. [ 64 ] approximate bi-attribute utilities by piecewise-linear functions with error bounds, and Guo et al. [ 25 ] build ambiguity sets from moment-type conditions. Hu et al. [ 33 ] model the decision maker’s utility as random with an ambiguous distribution, and Haskell et al. [ 29 ] consider ambiguity in the risk preferences and in the underlying probability distribution simultaneously, whereas Natarajan et al. [ 44 ] assume a known piecewise-linear concave utility and robustify only against ambiguity in the return distribution. Vayanos et al. [ 58 ] combine a robust model with linear utilities in a polyhedral uncertainty set and an elicitation process that refines the set from the answers to pairwise comparison queries. We also use linear utility functions, but represent uncertainty in their weights using an empirical percentile box in the outpatient study and a bootstrap interval in the emergency department study. Whereas Vayanos et al. [ 58 ] select comparison queries to maximize the worst-case utility, we study how variability and uncertainty in LLM-generated weights affect operational decisions .
paragraphs.zh: 当用于表示决策者偏好并将多个目标合并为单一目标的权重存在不确定性时，鲁棒优化 [ 3 ] 能够针对一组合理的权重或效用值中的最坏情况提供保护。 Ehrgott 等人对具有不确定参数的多目标问题的最小最大鲁棒性进行了形式化定义。 [ 17 ] ，而 Hu 和 Mehrotra [ 31 ] 研究了鲁棒和多随机加权的多目标模型，其中权重属于一个不确定性集合。 我们的鲁棒问题属于他们提出的多专家多标准鲁棒加权求和（McRow）方法中的确定性实例。 相关文献被称为偏好鲁棒优化（PRO），它通过从决策者处获取的部分信息来构建效用函数的模糊性集合。 Hu 和 Mehrotra [ 32 ] 针对一组风险规避的效用值构建了一个最大化最小模型，Wu 等人 [ 64 ] 使用带误差界的分段线性函数近似双属性效用，而 Guo 等人 [ 25 ] 基于矩类型条件构建模糊性集合。Hu 等人 [ 33 ] 将决策者的效用建模为具有模糊分布的随机变量，而 Haskell 等人 [ 29 ] 同时考虑了风险偏好和基础概率分布中的模糊性，而 Natarajan 等人 [ 44 ] 假设效用为已知的分段线性凹函数，并且仅针对回报分布中的模糊性进行鲁棒化处理。Vayanos 等人 [ 58 ] 将鲁棒模型与线性效用结合，置于一个多面体不确定性集合中，并通过一个从成对比较问题的答案中逐步完善该集合的提取过程来优化模型。 我们也使用线性效用函数，但在门诊研究中通过经验百分位箱、在急诊科研究中通过自助区间来表示其权重中的不确定性。而 Vayanos 等人 [ 58 ] 选择比较问题以最大化最坏情况下的效用，而我们则研究 LLM 生成的权重中的变异性与不确定性如何影响运营决策。

paragraphs.en: Our work relates to two applied areas. In operations research, LLMs are increasingly embedded in optimization pipelines with closed-loop evaluation, where objective feedback is used to filter or refine candidate solutions. FunSearch [ 49 ] and HeuriGym [ 10 ] evaluate LLM-generated programs and heuristics by executing them, Çetinkaya et al. [ 71 ] derive scheduling heuristics and validate them against exact methods, and Xiao et al. [ 65 ] coordinate domain-specialized agents that formulate and solve operations research problems. In healthcare, LLMs and multi-agent LLM systems have been evaluated for clinical triage [ 38 , 41 ] , for broader triage, referral, and diagnosis workflows [ 20 ] , for medical consultation [ 48 ] , for transitions from primary to specialist care [ 54 ] , and for summarizing patient dialogues [ 18 ] . In both areas, the LLM output can be checked against a solver, a simulator, a clinical reference, or human evaluation. The objective weights in this paper have no such reference , so we focus on diagnosing how reliable they are and on measuring their effect on decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作涉及两个应用领域。 在运筹学领域，大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被嵌入到具有闭环评估的优化流程中，其中目标反馈被用于筛选或优化候选解决方案。 FunSearch [ 49 ] 和 HeuriGym [ 10 ] 通过执行大型语言模型生成的程序和启发式方法对其进行评估，Çetinkaya 等人 [ 71 ] 推导出调度启发式方法，并通过精确方法进行验证，而 Xiao 等人 [ 65 ] 则协调领域专用智能体来构建和解决运筹学问题。 在医疗保健领域，大型语言模型和多智能体大型语言模型系统已被用于临床分诊 [ 38 , 41 ]、更广泛的分诊、转诊和诊断流程 [ 20 ]、医疗咨询 [ 48 ]、从初级医疗向专科医疗的过渡 [ 54 ]，以及患者对话的摘要生成 [ 18 ]。 在这两个领域，大型语言模型的输出都可以与求解器、模拟器、临床参考标准或人类评估进行比对。 本文中的目标权重没有此类参考依据，因此我们重点诊断其可靠性，并衡量其对决策的影响。

paragraphs.en: Outpatient appointment scheduling involves trade-offs among patient waiting time, provider idle time, and provider overtime [ 9 , 13 , 27 ] . Patients, providers, and operations staff weigh these criteria differently, and the weights may vary with clinic conditions. This section applies the LLM-PADA framework to study whether a team of LLM agents, each prompted with one stakeholder role, can supply such weights explicitly by reporting a numerical importance score for each criterion, and whether these scores are reliable enough to serve as coefficients of a scheduling objective. We use preference for the importance scores that an agent reports under the experimental prompts; whether these scores match the preferences of human patients, providers, or schedulers is outside the scope of the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 门诊预约排程需要在患者等待时间、医护人员空闲时间和医护人员加班时间之间进行权衡 [ 9 , 13 , 27 ] 。 患者、医护人员和运营人员对这些标准有不同的权衡，且其权重可能因诊所条件而异。 本节应用 LLM-PADA 框架，研究由 LLM 智能体组成的团队（每个智能体均被赋予一个利益相关者角色）是否能够通过为每个标准报告数值重要性分数来明确提供此类权重，以及这些分数是否足够可靠，可用作排程目标函数的系数。 我们采用智能体在实验提示下报告的重要性分数所反映的偏好；这些分数是否与人类患者、医护人员或排程员的偏好一致，则超出了本文的研究范围。

paragraphs.en: The first family of constraints ensures that each patient is scheduled no earlier than its earliest acceptable slot. The second preserves the prescribed order of the requests and prevents more than one request from being assigned to the same slot. Service durations are deterministic and known, the request order is fixed, and overbooking is not allowed. These choices remove sources of variation other than the weights, whose effect we study. Stochastic service durations and overbooking are central to the appointment scheduling literature [ 9 , 27 ] , but they are not needed to isolate this effect.
paragraphs.zh: 第一组约束确保每位患者都不会被安排在其最早可接受时段之前。 第二组约束保留了请求的预定顺序，并防止多个请求被分配至同一时段。 服务时长是确定且已知的，请求顺序是固定的，并且不允许超额预订。 这些设定排除了除权重以外的其他变异性来源，而权重的影响正是我们所研究的对象。 随机服务时长和超额预订在预约调度文献中占据核心地位 [9, 27]，但为了单独分析这一影响，它们并非必需。

paragraphs.en: We scalarize problem ( 3.3 ) with the weighted-sum method [ 43 , 16 ] , whose criterion weights represent trade-offs among the objectives, and we obtain these weights from a team of LLM agents representing different stakeholder perspectives. In Step 1 of LLM-PADA, each agent first reports numerical importance scores for the criteria ( elicitation ); the agents then observe one another’s scores and revise their own over several rounds ( deliberation ). We address four research questions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用加权求和法 [43, 16] 对问题 (3.3) 进行标量化，其标准权重代表了各目标之间的权衡关系，而这些权重则由代表不同利益相关者视角的 LLM 智能体团队提供。 在 LLM-PADA 的第一步中，每个智能体首先报告各项标准的数值重要性得分（提取阶段）；随后，这些智能体观察彼此的得分，并在多轮互动中修正自己的得分（协商阶段）。 我们将探讨四个研究问题。

sents.en: In Step 1 of LLM-PADA, each agent first reports numerical importance scores for the criteria ( elicitation ); the agents then observe one another’s scores and revise their own over several rounds ( deliberation ).
sents.zh: 在 LLM-PADA 的第一步中，每个智能体首先报告各项标准的数值重要性得分（提取阶段）；随后，这些智能体观察彼此的得分，并在多轮互动中修正自己的得分（协商阶段）。

sents.en: We address four research questions.
sents.zh: 我们将探讨四个研究问题。

paragraphs.en: Contextual sensitivity: Do an agent’s scores change as expected when the clinic’s operational state varies?
paragraphs.zh: 情境敏感性：当诊所的运行状态发生变化时，智能体的得分是否如预期那样改变？

paragraphs.en: Role differentiation: After deliberation, does each agent still assign greater relative importance to the criterion associated with its role than the other agents do?
paragraphs.zh: 角色分化：经过审议后，每个智能体是否仍然认为与其角色相关的标准比其他智能体更为重要？

paragraphs.en: Inter-agent dispersion: How much do the agents’ normalized weight vectors differ, and how do these differences change across deliberation rounds?
paragraphs.zh: 智能体间分散度：各智能体的归一化权重向量存在多大差异？这些差异在审议轮次中又会如何变化？

paragraphs.en: Scheduling consequences: How does accounting for uncertainty in the agents’ weights change the selected appointment schedule compared with using mean weights?
paragraphs.zh: 调度后果：与使用平均权重相比，考虑智能体重数中的不确定性会如何改变所选的预约安排？

paragraphs.en: Low inter-agent dispersion (Q3) means that the agents agree, but agreeing agents may still fail to respond to clinic conditions (Q1) or lose their role-specific priorities (Q2). We therefore assess (Q1)–(Q3) separately before studying the scheduling consequences of the resulting weights (Q4).
paragraphs.zh: 智能体间低分散性（Q3）意味着各智能体意见一致，但达成一致的智能体仍可能无法对临床状况作出响应（Q1），或失去其角色特定的优先事项（Q2）。 因此，在研究由此产生的权重（Q4）对调度造成的影响之前，我们将分别评估（Q1）–（Q3）。

sents.en: Low inter-agent dispersion (Q3) means that the agents agree, but agreeing agents may still fail to respond to clinic conditions (Q1) or lose their role-specific priorities (Q2).

sents.en: We therefore assess (Q1)–(Q3) separately before studying the scheduling consequences of the resulting weights (Q4).
sents.zh: 因此，在研究由此产生的权重（Q4）对调度造成的影响之前，我们将分别评估（Q1）–（Q3）。

paragraphs.en: We now describe how the four steps of LLM-PADA are implemented for the outpatient appointment scheduling problem. Step 1 produces the initial and revised preference weights. Step 2 assesses contextual sensitivity, role differentiation, and inter-agent dispersion to answer (Q1), (Q2), and (Q3), respectively. Step 3 constructs uncertainty sets for the weights, and Step 4 compares mean-weight and robust scheduling decisions to answer (Q4).
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在将描述 LLM-PADA 的四步流程如何用于门诊预约调度问题。 第一步生成初始偏好权重和修订后的偏好权重。 第二步评估情境敏感性、角色差异性和智能体间离散度，分别回答 (Q1)、(Q2) 和 (Q3)。 第三步为权重构建不确定性集合，第四步则比较平均权重调度决策与鲁棒调度决策，以回答 (Q4)。

paragraphs.en: Step 1 consists of the elicitation and deliberation stages described below. For deliberation, we compare three protocols: a numerical protocol, in which the agents exchange score vectors only; an argumentative protocol, in which they also exchange short written justifications and objections; and a mechanical protocol, in which a fixed rule moves each agent’s scores toward the group mean without LLM calls.
paragraphs.zh: 第一步包括下文描述的提取和审议阶段。 在审议阶段，我们比较三种协议：数值协议（智能体仅交换分数向量）；论证协议（它们还交换简短的书面理由和反对意见）；以及机械协议（通过固定规则将每个智能体的分数向群体均值靠拢，且不调用大语言模型）。

sents.en: Step 1 consists of the elicitation and deliberation stages described below.
sents.zh: 第一步包括下文描述的提取和审议阶段。

sents.en: For deliberation, we compare three protocols: a numerical protocol, in which the agents exchange score vectors only; an argumentative protocol, in which they also exchange short written justifications and objections; and a mechanical protocol, in which a fixed rule moves each agent’s scores toward the group mean without LLM calls.
sents.zh: 在审议阶段，我们比较三种协议：数值协议（智能体仅交换分数向量）；论证协议（它们还交换简短的书面理由和反对意见）；以及机械协议（通过固定规则将每个智能体的分数向群体均值靠拢，且不调用大语言模型）。

paragraphs.en: Let ℰ = { Intake , Provider , Scheduler } \mathcal{E}=\{\text{Intake},\text{Provider},\text{Scheduler}\} denote the set of agents and 𝒞 = { w , u , o } \mathcal{C}=\{w,u,o\} the set of criteria, where w w , u u , and o o denote patient waiting time, provider idle time, and provider overtime, respectively. In the elicitation stage, each agent receives a prompt specifying its stakeholder role. The role descriptions in these prompts emphasize timely patient access for the intake agent, a sustainable clinical workload for the provider agent, and efficient use of clinic capacity for the scheduler agent. Every agent scores all three criteria with the same definitions and the same scale. The role descriptions are fixed throughout elicitation and deliberation.
paragraphs.zh: 令 ℰ = { Intake , Provider , Scheduler } \mathcal{E}=\{\text{Intake},\text{Provider},\text{Scheduler}\} 表示智能体集合，𝒞 = { w , u , o } \mathcal{C}=\{w,u,o\} 表示标准集合，其中 w、u 和 o 分别表示患者等待时间、提供者空闲时间和提供者加班时间。 在信息收集阶段，每个智能体都会收到一个明确其利益相关者角色的提示。 这些提示中的角色描述强调：对于 Intake 智能体，要确保患者及时获得服务；对于 Provider 智能体，要保持临床工作负荷的可持续性；对于 Scheduler 智能体，则要高效利用诊所资源。 每个智能体都使用相同的定义和相同的量表对全部三个标准进行评分。 在整个信息收集和审议过程中，角色描述始终保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Let ℐ \mathcal{I} index the base clinic descriptions. Each description lists nine fields: current time, session end, patients seen, patients remaining, open slots, mean waiting time, provider idle time, projected overtime, and cancellations. For each description i ∈ ℐ i\in\mathcal{I} , we create four versions, one for each condition S ∈ 𝒮 = { B , HW , HO , CF } S\in\mathcal{S}=\{\mathrm{B},\mathrm{HW},\mathrm{HO},\mathrm{CF}\} . B (balanced) uses the base description without modification and serves as the reference. HW (high waiting) modifies the base description by increasing the displayed mean waiting time. HO (high overtime) modifies it by moving the displayed current time later and increasing the projected overtime. CF (context-free) contains no clinic description, as the prompt includes only the role description and the criteria. The numerical modifications and repetition counts are specified in Subsection 3.4.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 用 ℐ \mathcal{I} 对基础诊所描述进行索引。 每个描述包含九个字段：当前时间、会话结束时间、已接诊患者、剩余患者、可用时段、平均等待时间、服务提供者空闲时间、预计加班时间和取消预约数。 对于每个描述 i ∈ ℐ i\in\mathcal{I}，我们创建四个版本，分别对应条件 S ∈ 𝒮 = { B , HW , HO , CF } S\in\mathcal{S}=\{\mathrm{B},\mathrm{HW},\mathrm{HO},\mathrm{CF}\}。 B（平衡）版本直接使用基础描述不作修改，并作为参考基准。 HW（高等待）版本通过增加显示的平均等待时间来修改基础描述。 HO（高加班）版本通过将显示当前时间推迟以及增加预计加班时间来修改基础描述。 CF（无上下文）版本不包含任何诊所描述，因为提示仅包含角色描述和标准。 数值修改和重复次数在子章节 3.4.1 中进行了说明。

paragraphs.en: For every i ∈ ℐ i\in\mathcal{I} , conditions B, HW, and HO are built from the same base description and differ only in the fields that we manipulate. We call this a paired design , as the difference between an agent’s scores under HW (or HO) and under B for the same i i isolates the response to the manipulation. For example, the difference between HW and B is attributable to the displayed mean waiting time alone, while the difference between HO and B reflects the joint change in current time and projected overtime.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个 i ∈ ℐ，条件 B、HW 和 HO 都基于相同的基线描述构建，仅在我们操控的字段上存在差异。 我们称这种设计为配对设计，因为同一 i 下智能体在 HW（或 HO）条件下的得分与在 B 条件下的得分之差，能够单独反映对操控的响应。 例如，HW 与 B 之间的差异完全由所显示的平均等待时间引起，而 HO 与 B 之间的差异则反映了当前时间与预计超时时间的联合变化。

paragraphs.en: In the numerical protocol , the agent returns its revised score vector only, with integer components from 1 1 to 9 9 . In the argumentative protocol , in addition to the revised score vector, the agent returns (i) a one-sentence justification, (ii) an objection addressed to one other agent, (iii) the identifiers of the clinic-state fields that it used, and (iv) a reference to a preceding argument, if it relies on one. From round 2 onward, the argumentative prompt also contains the three argument records of the previous round, each with its validation status. A response is valid if its scores are integers from 1 1 to 9 9 and, in the argumentative protocol, if it contains all required fields, addresses its objection to another agent, and references only previous-round arguments by other agents. An invalid response is retried; once the permitted retries are exhausted, the failure is recorded and the agent’s previous-round score vector is carried forward.
paragraphs.zh: 在数值协议中，智能体仅返回其修订后的分数向量，其中各分量的整数范围从 1 到 9。 在论证协议中，除了修订后的分数向量外，智能体还需返回：(i) 一句理由说明；(ii) 针对另一智能体的反对意见；(iii) 其所使用的诊所状态字段的标识符；以及 (iv) 若依赖先前论点，则需引用该论点。 从第 2 轮开始，论证提示还包括上一轮的三条论证记录，每条均附有验证状态。 若响应中的分数为 1 到 9 之间的整数，并且在论证协议中包含了所有必要字段、将反对意见指向另一智能体，且仅引用其他智能体在前一轮提出的论点，则该响应有效。 无效的响应将被重试；一旦允许的重试次数用尽，该失败将被记录，并且智能体上一轮的分数向量将被保留并带入下一轮。

paragraphs.en: where s ¯ ( r ) \bar{s}^{(r)} is the mean score vector across agents, and α \alpha specifies the degree of averaging applied in each round. The rule preserves s ¯ ( r ) \bar{s}^{(r)} and moves each agent’s score vector toward this mean. It shows how much agreement, and how much attenuation of contextual and role-specific differences, arises from averaging alone, with no agent exercising any judgment. The protocol is close to the convergence step of Vahidnia [57] , which also moves the agents’ weights toward the group mean by a fixed rule rather than through deliberation among the agents.
paragraphs.zh: 其中 s ¯ ( r ) \bar{s}^{(r)} 是跨智能体的平均得分向量，而 α \alpha 指定了每轮应用的平均程度。 该规则保留 s ¯ ( r ) \bar{s}^{(r)}，并将每个智能体的得分向量向该平均值靠拢。 它展示了仅通过平均（没有任何智能体进行判断）会产生多大的共识，以及多大程度的情境和角色特定差异的减弱。 该协议与 Vahidnia [57] 中的收敛步骤相近，后者也通过固定规则而非智能体之间的商议，将智能体的权重向群体平均值靠拢。

paragraphs.en: The numerical and argumentative protocols, hereafter referred to as the LLM protocols, use the same scoring scale and also provide the agents with the same clinic descriptions. For each pair ( i , S ) (i,S) , we generate K K independent deliberation trajectories under each LLM protocol, using different random seeds. paragraphs.en: We call 𝒰 S , π \mathcal{U}_{S,\pi} an empirical percentile-box weight uncertainty set. It is a nonempty polyhedron by construction and reflects variation across stakeholder agents, base clinic descriptions, and, for the LLM protocols, deliberation trajectories. paragraphs.en: We use ten synthetic base clinic descriptions, ℐ = { 1 , … , 10 } \mathcal{I}=\{1,\ldots,10\} , and collect twenty elicitation responses, 𝒥 = { 1 , … , 20 } \mathcal{J}=\{1,\ldots,20\} , for each agent, description, and condition. Following the design in Subsection 3.3.1 , HW adds 25–40 minutes to the displayed mean waiting time, while HO moves the displayed current time two hours later, capped at 30 minutes before the session end, and adds 35–55 minutes to projected overtime. paragraphs.en: Deliberation proceeds for R = 3 R=3 rounds from the same initial score matrix under all three protocols. For each ( i , S ) (i,S) , we generate K = 5 K=5 independent trajectories under each LLM protocol, using different random seeds and temperature 0.2 0.2 . This gives 1,800 1{,}800 agent responses per LLM protocol, excluding retries. We use the lower temperature to reduce sampling variability across rounds so that score changes more clearly reflect the information exchanged during deliberation. The mechanical protocol uses α = 0.35 \alpha=0.35 , so each round moves every agent’s score 35% of the way toward the mean across agents for the same criterion. After three rounds, each score’s distance from this mean is approximately 27% of its initial distance. Invalid LLM responses receive up to two retries. For the reliability measures, we report 95% percentile bootstrap intervals based on 5,000 5{,}000 resamples of the ten base descriptions.

paragraphs.en: Before deliberation, the paired differences ( 3.7 ) show that the agents respond to the manipulated clinic conditions (Figure 2 ). Under HW, the mean paired difference in the waiting score is 0.560 points for Intake (95% bootstrap interval [ 0.225 , 0.845 ] [0.225,0.845] ), 0.695 for Provider ( [ 0.455 , 0.910 ] [0.455,0.910] ), and 0.506 for Scheduler ( [ 0.206 , 0.736 ] [0.206,0.736] ). All three intervals lie above zero, supporting an increase in the importance assigned to waiting when the displayed mean waiting time rises. Under HO, the overtime score increases by 2.872, 1.691, and 2.977 points for Intake, Provider, and Scheduler, respectively; all three intervals exclude zero. In contrast, HW decreases the overtime score by 0.611, 1.097, and 1.062 points for the three agents.

paragraphs.en: Deliberation attenuates these responses by an amount that depends on the agent and criterion (Figure 3 ). Averaged across agents, the HW–B difference in the waiting score decreases from 0.587 points before deliberation to 0.293 under the numerical protocol and 0.193 under the argumentative protocol. After numerical deliberation, the agent-specific mean differences are − 0.100 -0.100 , 0.300, and 0.680 for Intake, Provider, and Scheduler, respectively; after argumentative deliberation, they are 0.060, 0.040, and 0.480. For the HO–B difference in the overtime score, the mean across agents decreases from 2.513 before deliberation to 0.980 under the numerical protocol and 1.273 under the argumentative protocol, although all agent-specific differences remain positive. The argumentative protocol preserves a larger mean overtime response than the numerical protocol but a smaller mean waiting response, so neither LLM protocol consistently preserves the initial contextual responses better than the other ( Q1 takeaway ).

paragraphs.en: The argumentative protocol also records the arguments and clinic-state fields used during deliberation. Among the 1,170 valid argumentative turns in rounds 2 and 3, 1,118 (95.56%) cite a valid preceding argument from another agent (Table 2 ). Explicit references to the manipulated clinic indicators are less frequent. Mean waiting time is mentioned in 9.38% of valid HW turns and 3.36% of valid B turns, while projected overtime is mentioned in 13.53% of valid HO turns and 10.54% of valid B turns. Current time, which is also manipulated under HO, is referenced in 81.88% of valid HO turns and 76.23% of valid B turns. Valid terminal outputs account for 99.06% of numerical turns and 98.06% of argumentative turns.

paragraphs.en: The initial scores also differentiate the three roles. All 12 pre-deliberation role-differentiation scores RD e ( i , S ) \mathrm{RD}_{e}^{(i,S)} have 95% intervals entirely above zero (Table 3 ). This differentiation weakens substantially after the LLM exchanges. After numerical deliberation, three of the 12 intervals remain entirely above zero, three contain zero, and six lie entirely below zero. After argumentative deliberation, the corresponding counts are one, eight, and three. Mechanical averaging, in contrast, retains positive intervals for all 12 scores; this holds by construction, since the update in ( 3.6 ) brings the agents’ raw scores closer together while preserving their ordering. The LLM protocols thus weaken or reverse the initial role differences although the role descriptions are unchanged in every round ( Q2 takeaway ).

paragraphs.en: The importance scores elicited in Section 3 do not establish how an LLM agent trades an improvement in one objective against a deterioration in another. We apply the LLM-PADA framework to infer this trade-off from an agent’s choices between pairs of emergency department (ED) configurations. For each configuration, the agent sees two numerical outcomes: a measure of patient waiting time and the number of hours per week that a minor injuries unit (MIU) is open, where the MIU is a dedicated pathway for eligible low-acuity patients. Opening the MIU for more hours can reduce waiting times but requires a greater commitment of ED resources. The choice of the agent may depend on these outcomes and on which configuration is presented as Option 1 (we refer to this as a presentation effect ). We estimate a trade-off weight using a choice model that includes both the outcomes and presentation order, and assess its predictive value against a benchmark that uses presentation order alone.
paragraphs.zh: 第 3 节中得出的重要性分数并未说明 LLM 智能体如何在改善一个目标与恶化另一个目标之间进行权衡。 我们应用 LLM-PADA 框架，通过智能体在急诊科（ED）配置成对选择中的决策来推断这种权衡关系。 对于每种配置，智能体都会看到两个数值结果：患者等待时间的衡量指标，以及轻伤单元（MIU）每周开放的小时数；其中 MIU 是为符合条件的低危患者设立的专用通道。 延长 MIU 的开放时间可以减少等待时间，但需要投入更多的急诊科资源。 智能体的选择可能取决于这些结果，以及哪种配置被作为选项 1 呈现（我们将其称为“呈现效应”）。 我们使用一个同时包含结果和呈现顺序的选择模型来估计权衡权重，并评估其预测价值相对于仅使用呈现顺序的基准模型的表现。

sents.en: The importance scores elicited in Section 3 do not establish how an LLM agent trades an improvement in one objective against a deterioration in another.
sents.zh: 第 3 节中得出的重要性分数并未说明 LLM 智能体如何在改善一个目标与恶化另一个目标之间进行权衡。

sents.en: We apply the LLM-PADA framework to infer this trade-off from an agent’s choices between pairs of emergency department (ED) configurations.
sents.zh: 我们应用 LLM-PADA 框架，通过智能体在急诊科（ED）配置成对选择中的决策来推断这种权衡关系。

sents.en: For each configuration, the agent sees two numerical outcomes: a measure of patient waiting time and the number of hours per week that a minor injuries unit (MIU) is open, where the MIU is a dedicated pathway for eligible low-acuity patients.
sents.zh: 对于每种配置，智能体都会看到两个数值结果：患者等待时间的衡量指标，以及轻伤单元（MIU）每周开放的小时数；其中 MIU 是为符合条件的低危患者设立的专用通道。

sents.en: Opening the MIU for more hours can reduce waiting times but requires a greater commitment of ED resources.
sents.zh: 延长 MIU 的开放时间可以减少等待时间，但需要投入更多的急诊科资源。

sents.en: The choice of the agent may depend on these outcomes and on which configuration is presented as Option 1 (we refer to this as a presentation effect ).
sents.zh: 智能体的选择可能取决于这些结果，以及哪种配置被作为选项 1 呈现（我们将其称为“呈现效应”）。

sents.en: We estimate a trade-off weight using a choice model that includes both the outcomes and presentation order, and assess its predictive value against a benchmark that uses presentation order alone.
sents.zh: 我们使用一个同时包含结果和呈现顺序的选择模型来估计权衡权重，并评估其预测价值相对于仅使用呈现顺序的基准模型的表现。

paragraphs.en: We ask LLM agents prompted from patient, physician, and operations perspectives to compare configurations reported in the simulation study of Boresta et al. [6] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们从患者、医生和运营的角度出发，提示大型语言模型智能体（LLM agents），对 Boresta 等人 [6] 的模拟研究中报告的各种配置进行比较。

paragraphs.en: As in Section 3 , we do not claim that the inferred weights represent the preferences of human patients, physicians, or hospital operators.
paragraphs.zh: 与第 3 节中一样，我们并不声称推断出的权重代表了人类患者、医生或医院运营者的偏好。

paragraphs.en: We use the discrete-event simulation study of Boresta et al. [6] to define the operational setting. Its model represents stochastic patient arrivals, triage, and patient flow through the ED’s Medical Unit (MU), Surgical Unit (SU), and MIU. Let D = { 1 , … , 7 } D=\{1,\ldots,7\} index the days of a week. A configuration x = ( o 1 , q 1 , … , o 7 , q 7 , π m , π a ) x=(o_{1},q_{1},\ldots,o_{7},q_{7},\pi_{\mathrm{m}},\pi_{\mathrm{a}}) specifies the MIU opening time o d o_{d} and closing time q d q_{d} on each day d ∈ D d\in D , together with the percentages π m \pi_{\mathrm{m}} and π a \pi_{\mathrm{a}} of eligible patients routed to the MIU in the morning and afternoon, respectively. If the MIU is closed on a day, it follows that o d = q d o_{d}=q_{d} . The number of MIU rooms is fixed in this case study.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用 Boresta 等人 [6] 的离散事件模拟研究来定义运营设置。其模型描述了患者随机的到达、分诊，以及患者在急诊科的医疗单元（MU）、外科单元（SU）和 MIU 中的流动情况。令 D = { 1 , … , 7 } D=\{1,\ldots,7\} 表示一周中的每一天。配置 x = ( o 1 , q 1 , … , o 7 , q 7 , π m , π a ) x=(o_{1},q_{1},\ldots,o_{7},q_{7},\pi_{\mathrm{m}},\pi_{\mathrm{a}}) 指定了每一天 d ∈ D d\in D 的 MIU 开放时间 o d o_{d} 和关闭时间 q d q_{d}，以及分别将符合条件的患者在上午和下午转诊至 MIU 的百分比 π m \pi_{\mathrm{m}} 和 π a \pi_{\mathrm{a}}。如果 MIU 在某一天关闭，则必有 o d = q d o_{d}=q_{d}。在本案例研究中，MIU 的房间数量是固定的。

paragraphs.en: The patient, physician, and operations prompts each describe the two outcomes, average waiting times and MIU opening hours, from their respective perspectives, but none assigns a numerical weight to either outcome. Unlike Section 3 , where each role description is associated with one criterion, we do not posit an expected weight for any role and estimate the weight from the agent’s pairwise choices. Our analysis asks:
paragraphs.zh: 患者、医生和运营提示各自从自身角度描述了两种结果——平均等待时间和 MIU 开放时间，但没有任何一种提示为这两种结果赋予数值权重。 与第 3 节不同，在第 3 节中每个角色描述都与一个标准相关联；而在此处，我们并未对任何角色设定预期权重，而是通过智能体的成对选择来估计其权重。我们的分析提出以下问题：

sents.en: The patient, physician, and operations prompts each describe the two outcomes, average waiting times and MIU opening hours, from their respective perspectives, but none assigns a numerical weight to either outcome.
sents.zh: 患者、医生和运营提示各自从自身角度描述了两种结果——平均等待时间和 MIU 开放时间，但没有任何一种提示为这两种结果赋予数值权重。

sents.en: Unlike Section 3 , where each role description is associated with one criterion, we do not posit an expected weight for any role and estimate the weight from the agent’s pairwise choices. Our analysis asks:
sents.zh: 与第 3 节不同，在第 3 节中每个角色描述都与一个标准相关联；而在此处，我们并未对任何角色设定预期权重，而是通过智能体的成对选择来估计其权重。我们的分析提出以下问题：

paragraphs.en: Predictive relevance: For pairs of configurations not used to estimate the trade-off, do their waiting-time and opening-hour outcomes improve prediction of the agent’s choice beyond a model that accounts for which option is presented first?
paragraphs.zh: 预测相关性：对于未用于估计权衡关系的配置对，其等待时间和营业时间结果是否能在超越仅考虑哪个选项先被呈现的模型的基础上，进一步改善对智能体选择的预测？

paragraphs.en: Choice consistency: How consistent are the agents’ choices across repeated requests and reversed presentation orders, and to what extent do they favor a configuration that is strictly better on both outcomes?
paragraphs.zh: 选择一致性：在重复请求和展示顺序反转的情况下，智能体的选择有多一致？它们在多大程度上会偏好一种在两个结果上都严格更优的配置？

paragraphs.en: Weight uncertainty: How much uncertainty remains in the inferred trade-off weights across the tested models and stakeholder roles?
paragraphs.zh: 权重不确定性：在已测试的模型和利益相关者角色中，推断出的权衡权重仍存在多大程度的不确定性？

paragraphs.en: Configuration consequences: How does accounting for uncertainty in the estimated trade-off weight affect the selected configuration compared with using a single weight?
paragraphs.zh: 配置影响：与仅使用单一权重相比，在估计的权衡权重中考虑不确定性会对所选配置产生何种影响？

paragraphs.en: We now describe how the four steps of LLM-PADA are implemented for ED configuration selection. Step 1 infers a trade-off weight from pairwise choices. Step 2 assesses predictive relevance and choice consistency to answer (Q1) and (Q2). Step 3 constructs an uncertainty set for the inferred weight and supports the analysis of (Q3). Step 4 compares mean-weight, fitted-weight, and robust (McRow) configuration selection to answer (Q4).
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在将描述 LLM-PADA 的四步流程如何用于 ED 配置选择。 第一步通过成对选择推断出权衡权重。 第二步评估预测相关性和选择一致性，以回答 (Q1) 和 (Q2)。 第三步为推断出的权重构建不确定性集合，并支持对 (Q3) 的分析。 第四步比较平均权重、拟合权重和稳健 (McRow) 配置选择，以回答 (Q4)。

paragraphs.en: Consider an unordered pair h = { i , j } h=\{i,j\} with distinct i , j ∈ 𝒜 i,j\in\mathcal{A} . Label its members so that f w ​ ( x i ) < f w ​ ( x j ) f_{w}(x^{i})<f_{w}(x^{j}) and f cost ​ ( x i ) > f cost ​ ( x j ) f_{\mathrm{cost}}(x^{i})>f_{\mathrm{cost}}(x^{j}) . Thus, x i x^{i} denotes the configuration with lower waiting time but more MIU opening hours. Define Δ ​ w h = w ⁡ ( x j ) − w ⁡ ( x i ) > 0 \Delta w_{h}=w(x^{j})-w(x^{i})>0 and Δ ​ c h = c ⁡ ( x i ) − c ⁡ ( x j ) > 0 \Delta c_{h}=c(x^{i})-c(x^{j})>0 . Let z = 1 z=1 when x i x^{i} is presented as Option 1 and z = − 1 z=-1 when it is presented as Option 2. For each presentation order z z , let Y h , z = 1 Y_{h,z}=1 if the agent selects the lower-waiting configuration x i x^{i} , and Y h , z = 0 Y_{h,z}=0 if it selects x j x^{j} . For example, suppose x i x^{i} has outcomes ( 90 ​ minutes , 60 ​ hours ) (90\text{ minutes},60\text{ hours}) and x j x^{j} has outcomes ( 94 ​ minutes , 48 ​ hours ) (94\text{ minutes},48\text{ hours}) . In the comparison ( h , 1 ) (h,1) , x i x^{i} is Option 1; selecting it gives Y h , 1 = 1 Y_{h,1}=1 . In the separate comparison ( h , − 1 ) (h,-1) , x j x^{j} is Option 1; selecting it gives Y h , − 1 = 0 Y_{h,-1}=0 . The responses Y h , 1 Y_{h,1} and Y h , − 1 Y_{h,-1} therefore correspond to separate comparisons of the same pair in opposite orders. For each combination of LLM model and agent role, we fit an outcome-based choice model , which is a logistic regression that predicts selection of the lower-waiting configuration from the two normalized outcome differences and the presentation order:

paragraphs.en: We compare ( 4.4 ) with two benchmarks that use different information to predict a choice. The position-only benchmark , p h , z pos = σ ⁡ ( γ 0 ​ z ) p^{\mathrm{pos}}_{h,z}=\sigma(\gamma_{0}z) , assigns the same probability σ ⁡ ( γ 0 ) \sigma(\gamma_{0}) of selecting Option 1 in every comparison, regardless of the configurations’ waiting times and MIU opening hours. It can capture a tendency to choose Option 1, but does not use the numerical differences in waiting time or MIU opening hours. The Bradley–Terry benchmark [ 7 ] is p h , z BT = σ ⁡ ( v i − v j + γ BT ​ z ) p^{\mathrm{BT}}_{h,z}=\sigma(v_{i}-v_{j}+\gamma_{\mathrm{BT}}z) , where v a v_{a} is a score estimated for configuration a ∈ 𝒜 a\in\mathcal{A} . A larger score makes a configuration more likely to be selected. This benchmark also accounts for presentation order, but it estimates a separate score for each configuration instead of requiring its choices to follow one common weighted trade-off between waiting time and opening hours. We compare this benchmark with ( 4.4 ) on pairs that were not used to fit either model, to assess whether estimating a separate score for each configuration improves prediction.

paragraphs.en: All comparisons among the eleven simulated ED configurations involve a trade-off: the configuration with lower waiting time has more MIU opening hours. To assess whether presentation order can lead an agent to choose an alternative that is worse on both outcomes, we construct five additional pairs specified by numerical waiting times and opening hours rather than drawn from the eleven configurations. In each pair, one alternative has both lower waiting time and fewer opening hours than the other, so it is preferred under J λ J_{\lambda} for every λ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \lambda\in[0,1] . We present each pair in both orders, yielding ten additional choices per model and role. We define as dominance compliance the number of these ten choices in which the agent selects the alternative with both lower outcomes. These responses are excluded from model estimation and holdout prediction.

paragraphs.en: We summarize evidence for a fitted trade-off through an exploratory diagnostic screen . A combination of model and role meets the screen if the lower endpoint of its Δ ​ B \Delta B interval is positive, dominance compliance is 10/10, and 0 < λ ^ < 1 0<\widehat{\lambda}<1 . The first two conditions require evidence of predictive improvement beyond presentation order and observed compliance with strict dominance. The third identifies a fitted trade-off involving both objectives: since λ ^ = θ ^ w / ( θ ^ w + θ ^ c ) \widehat{\lambda}=\widehat{\theta}_{w}/(\widehat{\theta}_{w}+\widehat{\theta}_{c}) , an interior weight requires both objective coefficients to be positive. An endpoint weight can represent exclusive priority for one objective and is not intrinsically invalid; the screen is specifically intended to summarize evidence for a trade-off between the two objectives. We report order agreement separately. The screen was defined after inspecting the results and is descriptive; its intervals are not adjusted for multiple comparisons.

paragraphs.en: For Qwen3.5-9B, the outcome-based model in ( 4.4 ) attains holdout accuracies of 87.1%, 90.3%, and 85.5% for Patient, Physician, and Operations, respectively. The position-only benchmark defined in Section 4.3.2 attains the same accuracies: both models predict selection of Option 1 in every holdout comparison. These accuracies therefore reflect the frequency of first-option selections and do not show an advantage from using outcome differences. The Brier-score improvements Δ ​ B \Delta B defined in ( 4.6 ) range from 0.002 to 0.006, and all three intervals contain zero (Table 4 ). Thus, the holdout results provide limited evidence of predictive improvement beyond presentation order for this model.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 Qwen3.5-9B，(4.4) 中的基于结果的模型在患者、医生和运营方面分别获得了 87.1%、90.3% 和 85.5% 的保留集准确率。 第 4.3.2 节中定义的位置唯一基准也达到了相同的准确率：两种模型在所有保留集比较中都预测选择了选项 1。 因此，这些准确率反映了首次选择第一个选项的频率，并未体现出利用结果差异所带来的优势。 (4.6) 中定义的布里尔分数改进量 Δ B 的取值范围在 0.002 到 0.006 之间，且三个区间均包含零（表 4）。 因此，对于该模型而言，保留集结果仅提供了有限证据，表明其预测能力在展示顺序之外并无显著提升。

paragraphs.en: For Qwen3.5-27B, the results differ by role. For Patient, the Brier score decreases from 0.170 under the position-only benchmark to 0.095 under the outcome-based model, giving Δ ​ B = 0.075 \Delta B=0.075 with interval [ 0.032 , 0.119 ] [0.032,0.119] . For Operations, it decreases from 0.213 to 0.142, giving Δ ​ B = 0.071 \Delta B=0.071 with interval [ 0.033 , 0.109 ] [0.033,0.109] . Both intervals have positive lower endpoints, supporting a predictive contribution from the outcome differences. For Physician, Δ ​ B = 0.009 \Delta B=0.009 with interval [ − 0.030 , 0.048 ] [-0.030,0.048] , so the same conclusion is not supported. Taken together, the holdout results support a predictive contribution from outcome differences beyond presentation order for 27B Patient and Operations, while remaining inconclusive for the other four combinations of model and role ( Q1 takeaway ). The Bradley–Terry benchmark defined in Section 4.3.2 does not consistently improve the holdout Brier score over the outcome-based model. Assigning a separate score to each configuration therefore provides no consistent predictive advantage in this experiment.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 Qwen3.5-27B，不同角色的结果存在差异。 对于“患者”角色，Brier 评分从仅基于位置的基准模型下的 0.170 降至基于结果的模型下的 0.095，得到 Δ B = 0.075 \Delta B=0.071，置信区间为 [ 0.032 , 0.119 ] [0.032,0.119]。 对于“操作”角色，该评分从 0.213 降至 0.142，得到 Δ B = 0.071 \Delta B=0.071，置信区间为 [ 0.033 , 0.109 ] [0.033,0.109]。 两个置信区间的下限均为正值，表明结果差异对预测具有贡献作用。 对于“医生”角色，Δ B = 0.009 \Delta B=0.009，置信区间为 [ − 0.030 , 0.048 ] [-0.030,0.048]，因此无法得出相同结论。 综合来看，保留集结果支持在 27B 的“患者”和“操作”角色中，结果差异对预测具有超出呈现顺序的贡献作用；而对于其他四种模型与角色的组合，结论仍不明确（Q1 要点）。 第 4.3.2 节中定义的 Bradley–Terry 基准模型在保留集上的 Brier 评分并未始终优于基于结果的模型。 因此，在此实验中，为每种配置分配独立的评分并未带来一致的预测优势。

sents.en: For Qwen3.5-27B, the results differ by role.
sents.zh: 对于 Qwen3.5-27B，不同角色的结果存在差异。

sents.en: For Patient, the Brier score decreases from 0.170 under the position-only benchmark to 0.095 under the outcome-based model, giving Δ ​ B = 0.075 \Delta B=0.075 with interval [ 0.032 , 0.119 ] [0.032,0.119] .
sents.zh: 对于“患者”角色，Brier 评分从仅基于位置的基准模型下的 0.170 降至基于结果的模型下的 0.095，得到 Δ B = 0.075 \Delta B=0.071，置信区间为 [ 0.032 , 0.119 ] [0.032,0.119]。

sents.en: For Operations, it decreases from 0.213 to 0.142, giving Δ ​ B = 0.071 \Delta B=0.071 with interval [ 0.033 , 0.109 ] [0.033,0.109] .
Both intervals have positive lower endpoints, supporting a predictive contribution from the outcome differences.
sents.zh: 两个置信区间的下限均为正值，表明结果差异对预测具有贡献作用。

sents.en: For Physician, Δ ​ B = 0.009 \Delta B=0.009 with interval [ − 0.030 , 0.048 ] [-0.030,0.048] , so the same conclusion is not supported.

Taken together, the holdout results support a predictive contribution from outcome differences beyond presentation order for 27B Patient and Operations, while remaining inconclusive for the other four combinations of model and role ( Q1 takeaway ).
sents.zh: 综合来看，保留集结果支持在 27B 的“患者”和“操作”角色中，结果差异对预测具有超出呈现顺序的贡献作用；而对于其他四种模型与角色的组合，结论仍不明确（Q1 要点）。

sents.en: The Bradley–Terry benchmark defined in Section 4.3.2 does not consistently improve the holdout Brier score over the outcome-based model.
sents.zh: 第 4.3.2 节中定义的 Bradley–Terry 基准模型在保留集上的 Brier 评分并未始终优于基于结果的模型。

sents.en: Assigning a separate score to each configuration therefore provides no consistent predictive advantage in this experiment.
sents.zh: 因此，在此实验中，为每种配置分配独立的评分并未带来一致的预测优势。

paragraphs.en: For (Q2), the 9B behavioral diagnostics reinforce this limitation. Order agreement ranges from 0.19 to 0.26, and the alternative with both lower outcomes is selected in seven to nine of the ten dominance comparisons. All six selections of the dominated alternative across the three roles occur when the dominating alternative is presented as Option 2.
paragraphs.zh: 对于（Q2），9B 行为诊断进一步证实了这一局限性。 排序一致性范围在 0.19 到 0.26 之间，而在十次支配性比较中，有七到九次选择了两个结果都较低的那个替代方案。 在所有三种角色中，被支配的替代方案被选中的全部六次情况，都发生在支配性替代方案以“选项 2”的形式呈现时。

sents.en: For (Q2), the 9B behavioral diagnostics reinforce this limitation.
sents.zh: 对于（Q2），9B 行为诊断进一步证实了这一局限性。

sents.en: Order agreement ranges from 0.19 to 0.26, and the alternative with both lower outcomes is selected in seven to nine of the ten dominance comparisons.

sents.zh: 在所有三种角色中，被支配的替代方案被选中的全部六次情况，都发生在支配性替代方案以“选项 2”的形式呈现时。

paragraphs.en: All three 27B roles select the dominating alternative in all ten additional comparisons, but their choices among the eleven nondominated configurations remain sensitive to presentation order. Option 1 is selected in 82.3%, 82.3%, and 69.4% of the holdout responses for Patient, Physician, and Operations, respectively. The paired presentation design provides a 50% reference rate: if an agent deterministically selects the same configuration in both orders, that configuration is Option 1 in exactly one of the two comparisons. If choices are stochastic but their probabilities do not depend on order, the expected proportion of Option 1 selections is likewise 50%, although a realized sample need not attain this value. The observed proportions are above this reference and describe a tendency to select the first option.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有十项额外比较中，三个 27B 智能体都选择了占主导地位的选项，但它们在十一项非支配配置中的选择仍然对呈现顺序敏感。 在保留样本的回应中，患者、医生和运营组分别有 82.3%、82.3% 和 69.4% 的选择了选项 1。 配对呈现设计提供了一个 50% 的参考率：如果一个智能体在两种顺序中都确定地选择相同的配置，那么该配置在两项比较中恰好有一项是选项 1。 如果选择是随机的，但其概率不依赖于顺序，那么选项 1 选择的期望比例同样为 50%，尽管实际样本未必能达到这一数值。 观察到的比例高于这一参考值，表明存在选择第一个选项的倾向。

sents.en: All three 27B roles select the dominating alternative in all ten additional comparisons, but their choices among the eleven nondominated configurations remain sensitive to presentation order.

paragraphs.en: Order agreement is 0.35, 0.29, and 0.61 for the three 27B roles. Because each order is evaluated through a separate stochastic request, disagreement can reflect sampling variability as well as presentation effects; order agreement alone does not separate them. Across all six combinations of model and role, agreement between the original and repeated responses to the same ordered estimation comparison ranges from 75.0% to 89.6%. Thus, neither repeatability under a fixed presentation nor full compliance in the dominance comparisons establishes consistency across presentation orders when the alternatives involve a trade-off ( Q2 takeaway ).
paragraphs.zh: 对于三种 27B 角色，订单一致性分别为 0.35、0.29 和 0.61。 由于每个订单都通过独立的随机请求进行评估，不一致性可能既反映采样变异性，也反映呈现效应；仅凭订单一致性无法区分这两者。 在所有六种模型与角色的组合中，针对相同有序估计比较的原始响应与重复响应之间的一致性范围在 75.0% 到 89.6% 之间。 因此，无论是固定呈现下的可重复性，还是在优势比较中的完全遵从，都无法确立在不同呈现顺序下的一致性，当选项之间存在权衡时尤其如此（Q2 要点）。

paragraphs.en: Only 27B Patient and 27B Operations meet the screen defined in Section 4.3.2 . For 27B Physician, dominance compliance of 10/10 and an interior fitted weight coexist with an inconclusive holdout Brier comparison. None of the 9B combinations meets the screen.

paragraphs.en: One possible explanation for the weaker Physician result concerns how the role description relates to the operational criteria. Patient and Operations perspectives can suggest concerns about waiting time and resource use, respectively, whereas a Physician perspective may give less direct guidance about their relative importance. However, none of the prompts specifies an objective weight, and the current experiment does not test this explanation. In particular, an inconclusive Brier-score comparison does not establish that the Physician agent is indifferent between the objectives or has no preference. As shown in Section 4.3.1 , λ \lambda describes the relative coefficients, whereas κ = θ w + θ c \kappa=\theta_{w}+\theta_{c} determines how strongly objective differences affect choice probabilities. A model can have an interior weight without yielding a detectable predictive improvement beyond presentation order. Testing the proposed role interpretation would require a controlled comparison of prompts that differ in how explicitly they connect the Physician perspective to these criteria.
paragraphs.zh: 对“医生”智能体结果较弱的一种可能解释，涉及角色描述与操作标准之间的关系。 “患者”和“运营”视角分别可能引发对等待时间和资源使用的担忧，而“医生”视角则可能较少直接指导这些要素的相对重要性。 然而，没有任何提示指定了目标权重，当前实验也未验证这一解释。 特别地，Brier得分的比较结果尚无定论，这并不能说明“医生”智能体对各个目标无差异或没有偏好。 如第4.3.1节所示，λ（lambda）描述了相对系数，而κ = θ_w + θ_c则决定了目标差异对选择概率的影响强度。 一个模型可能具有内部权重，但并不会在预测表现上产生超出呈现顺序的显著改善。 要验证所提出的角色解释，需要受控比较那些在将“医生”视角与这些标准明确关联程度上有差异的提示。

sents.en: Patient and Operations perspectives can suggest concerns about waiting time and resource use, respectively, whereas a Physician perspective may give less direct guidance about their relative importance.

sents.en: In particular, an inconclusive Brier-score comparison does not establish that the Physician agent is indifferent between the objectives or has no preference.

sents.en: As shown in Section 4.3.1 , λ \lambda describes the relative coefficients, whereas κ = θ w + θ c \kappa=\theta_{w}+\theta_{c} determines how strongly objective differences affect choice probabilities.

paragraphs.en: Table 4 reports the fitted weights and their bootstrap intervals. For Qwen3.5-9B, the intervals for Patient and Physician span [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , while the Physician and Operations fits have θ ^ c = 0 \widehat{\theta}_{c}=0 and hence λ ^ = 1 \widehat{\lambda}=1 . A zero opening-hour coefficient means that the fitted model assigns no marginal effect to additional opening hours after accounting for the waiting-time difference and presentation order. Together with the holdout and behavioral diagnostics, the broad intervals and endpoint estimates provide weak support for interpreting the fitted ratios as operational trade-offs.
paragraphs.zh: 表 4 报告了拟合权重及其自助区间。 对于 Qwen3.5-9B，患者和医生的区间跨越 [0, 1]，而医生和操作的拟合结果中 θ ^ c = 0，因此 λ ^ = 1。 零的开放时段系数意味着，在考虑了等待时间差异和就诊顺序之后，拟合模型并未将额外开放时段分配任何边际效应。 结合预留集诊断和行为诊断，宽泛的区间和终点估计为将拟合比率解释为运营权衡提供了较弱的支持。

paragraphs.en: For Qwen3.5-27B, the fitted weights are 0.75, 0.72, and 0.64 for Patient, Physician, and Operations, respectively. Under the fixed normalization in ( 4.2 ), each point estimate places more weight on waiting time than on opening hours. The bootstrap intervals are narrower than their 9B counterparts for all three roles, although the Patient and Physician intervals still extend to 1 1 . Only the Operations interval is contained in ( 0 , 1 ) (0,1) . The intervals overlap substantially, and we do not perform a formal comparison of the weights across roles. The point estimates therefore describe the fitted objectives without establishing differences between stakeholder roles. The intervals indicate less uncertainty in the inferred weights for 27B than for 9B, but only 27B Operations has an interval that excludes both endpoint weights ( Q3 takeaway ).

paragraphs.en: The analysis connects preference inference to configuration selection while retaining the limits of the choice evidence. Outcome differences improve holdout prediction beyond presentation order for two of the six combinations. Accounting for weight uncertainty changes the configuration selected by (MW) in five of the six cases, with higher average group waiting time and fewer MIU opening hours ( Q4 takeaway ). The associated changes are quantified in waiting minutes, opening hours, and weighted objective values. These are conditional decision consequences for the eleven reported configurations; they do not establish alignment with human stakeholder preferences or clinical effectiveness. Extending the decision set beyond these configurations would require evaluating additional operating schedules and routing decisions through the ED simulation while retaining the chosen preference representation and normalization.
paragraphs.zh: 该分析将偏好推断与配置选择联系起来，同时保留了选择证据的局限性。 在六个组合中有两个组合中，结果差异使保留集预测超越了呈现顺序的影响。 考虑权重不确定性会改变（MW）在六个案例中的五个所选配置，导致平均群体等待时间更长，MIU 开放时间更少（Q4 结论）。 相关变化以等待分钟数、开放时间和加权目标值进行量化。 这些是报告中的十一种配置所对应的条件决策后果；它们并未证明与人类利益相关者的偏好或临床有效性一致。 要将决策集扩展到这些配置之外，就需要通过急诊科模拟评估额外的运行计划和路由决策，同时保留所选的偏好表示和归一化方法。

paragraphs.en: We proposed LLM-PADA to assess LLM-generated preferences as inputs to multi-objective optimization. The framework considers explicit preferences elicited as criterion importance scores and implicit preferences inferred from pairwise choices between alternatives. It evaluates their reliability, constructs uncertainty sets for the resulting weights, and compares decisions obtained through mean-weight and robust optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 LLM-PADA，用于将 LLM 生成的偏好作为多目标优化的输入进行评估。 该框架将明确表达的偏好作为标准重要性分数进行考量，并从备选方案之间的成对选择中推断出隐含偏好。 它评估这些偏好的可靠性，为由此产生的权重构建不确定性集合，并比较通过平均权重和鲁棒优化所得到的决策。

sents.en: We proposed LLM-PADA to assess LLM-generated preferences as inputs to multi-objective optimization.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 LLM-PADA，用于将 LLM 生成的偏好作为多目标优化的输入进行评估。

sents.en: The framework considers explicit preferences elicited as criterion importance scores and implicit preferences inferred from pairwise choices between alternatives.
sents.zh: 该框架将明确表达的偏好作为标准重要性分数进行考量，并从备选方案之间的成对选择中推断出隐含偏好。

sents.en: It evaluates their reliability, constructs uncertainty sets for the resulting weights, and compares decisions obtained through mean-weight and robust optimization.
sents.zh: 它评估这些偏好的可靠性，为由此产生的权重构建不确定性集合，并比较通过平均权重和鲁棒优化所得到的决策。

paragraphs.en: In outpatient scheduling, deliberation weakened contextual responses and sometimes reversed role differences. In ED planning, outcome differences improved holdout prediction beyond presentation order for two of six model–role combinations, but choices remained sensitive to order. These results show that agreement and predictive performance alone are insufficient to establish preference reliability. Compared with mean-weight optimization, the robust models selected different decisions in ten of sixteen outpatient comparisons and five of six ED comparisons. The comparison quantifies the loss at the mean weights incurred to reduce the worst-case weighted objective, for fixed operational data and objective normalizations. This protection applies to the specified weight sets; it does not validate importance scores as objective weights or establish that inferred trade-offs represent stakeholder preferences.
paragraphs.zh: 在门诊排程中，审慎决策削弱了情境响应，有时甚至逆转了角色差异。 在急诊科规划中，对于六种模型与角色的组合中的两种，结果差异使预测效果超越了呈现顺序的影响，但选择仍然对顺序敏感。 这些结果表明，仅凭一致性和预测性能不足以确立偏好的可靠性。 与均值加权优化相比，稳健模型在十六项门诊比较中有十项、在六项急诊科比较中有五项选择了不同的决策。 该比较量化了在固定运营数据和目标函数归一化条件下，为减少最坏情况下的加权目标而牺牲的均值加权性能损失。 这种保护适用于指定的权重集合；它并未验证重要性分数作为目标权重的有效性，也未证明推断出的权衡关系代表了利益相关者的偏好。

paragraphs.en: Future work should first compare agents and human stakeholders under the same elicitation tasks, assessing agreement in both the stated trade-offs and the decisions they imply. Replication across model families would test the scope of the findings. Further decision models could explicitly account for uncertainty in simulated outcomes alongside uncertainty in preference weights.
paragraphs.zh: 未来的研究应首先在同一信息收集任务下比较智能体与人类利益相关者，评估他们在所陈述的权衡取舍以及由此产生的决策方面的一致性。 在不同模型家族中重复实验将检验这些发现的范围。 进一步的决策模型可以明确地将模拟结果中的不确定性纳入考量，同时考虑偏好权重中的不确定性。

paragraphs.en: Table 8 reports the componentwise bounds used to construct the uncertainty sets 𝒰 S , π \mathcal{U}_{S,\pi} in ( 3.10 ). For each condition and weight source, the lower and upper bounds are the empirical 5th and 95th percentiles of the normalized criterion weights. These bounds summarize variation across agents and base clinic descriptions and, for the numerical and argumentative protocols, repeated deliberation trajectories. Together with nonnegativity and the requirement that the three weights sum to one, they define the weight vectors considered by the robust scheduling model.

paragraphs.en: The prompts request criterion importance; they do not present the seven-request scheduling instance, candidate appointment patterns, or the reference scales of 120, 60, and 60 minutes later used in the objective. Using the normalized importance scores as weights for these objectives is an assumption of the scheduling experiment. The elicitation wording for idle time refers to intervals between patients; the scheduling implementation additionally counts any initial gap before the first service, as specified above.
paragraphs.zh: 提示词要求明确各项标准的重要性，但并未提供七请求调度实例、候选预约模式，或目标函数中稍后使用的 120、60 和 60 分钟参考尺度。 将归一化后的重要性分数用作这些目标的权重，是本次调度实验的一个假设。 空闲时间的获取表述指的是患者之间的时间间隔；而调度实现还额外计算了首次服务之前的任何初始间隙，如上文所述。

paragraphs.en: The argumentative response requires waiting , idle , overtime , state_variables_used , reason , target_agent , referenced_argument , and objection . Ollama receives a strict JSON schema in addition to the text prompt. The scripts independently validate the responses and reject self-targeting and invalid argument references. Each deliberation request permits up to two retries. If no valid response is obtained, the failure is recorded and the agent’s previous-round score vector is carried forward. Every raw attempt is retained. The complete instantiated prompts and outputs are available in the JSONL audit files.
paragraphs.zh: 论证性回应需要等待、空闲、超时、使用的状态变量、理由、目标智能体、引用的论点以及反对意见。 Ollama 除了文本提示外，还会接收一个严格的 JSON 模式。 脚本会独立验证回应，并拒绝自我指向和无效的论点引用。 每次审议请求最多允许两次重试。 如果未获得有效回应，则会记录失败，并将该智能体上一轮的分值向量保留下来。 每一次原始尝试都会被保留。 完整的实例化提示和输出均可在 JSONL 审计文件中找到。
